name: AUTH-02 未登录：BLE 全功能可用，仅云备份禁用

setup.code: const c = globalThis.__cloudMock; if (!c) throw new Error('cloud-mock 未注入'); c.setScenario({ login: { responses: [{ status: 401, body: { error: { code: 'AUTH_INVALID', message: 'not logged in' } } }] } }); c.reset(); wx.clearStorageSync(); const app = getApp(); if (app.cloudSync && app.cloudSync.clearLocalOnly) app.cloudSync.clearLocalOnly(); return { loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), session: wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession') || null };

steps.code: const app = getApp(); return { loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), session: wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession') || null };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p.data.devices[0]; if (!d) throw new Error('设备列表为空：扫描未发现 ML-8DCC'); return p.onTapDevice({ currentTarget: { dataset: { deviceId: d.deviceId, name: d.name } } });
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { route: p.route, deviceId: p.data.deviceId, connected: !!p.data.connected, error: p.data.error || '' };
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; p.restoreFromCloud(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); return { transferMessage: p.data.transferMessage || '' };

assertions.code: const app = getApp(); const raw = wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession'); const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), hasSession: !!raw, localOnly: app.cloudSync.isLocalOnly(), hasSync: !!app.cloudSync, connected: !!(p && p.data.connected), restoreMessage: p && p.data.transferMessage };
